description:
Every decision in Washington has a price, and somebody pays it. Uncle Sam's Math
works out who, and how much.

Each week we take one policy or one line of the federal budget and lay out what the
public record says: the CBO estimate, the BLS price index, the Treasury statement.
Then we do the part nobody does. We put the number next to your grocery bill.

What you will find here:

- What a tariff adds to the shelf price, and who absorbs the rest
- Why the grocery average hides the item that actually went up
- Where a tax dollar goes, broken down by the Treasury's own ledger
- What a cost of living raise gives back, and what takes it away
- Programs with a published cost per household

We do not take a side and we do not predict. Every figure comes from a named,
published source, and it is on screen when we say it. When estimates disagree, we
show all of them and name who produced each.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. government.

The government's numbers, checked.
